profile.name: Ed Dobbles
profile.summary: C-suite analytics and AI executive with 25+ years architecting analytics functions that transform data into competitive advantage for Fortune 500 companies and high-growth ventures. Track record leading teams of 60+ FTEs, managing $17M+ budgets, and delivering $300M+ in measurable enterprise impact through strategic analytics, AI/ML implementation, and cultural transformation. Translates complex data into board-level insights and executable strategies that drive revenue growth, operational excellence, and market differentiation.

ens.core_identity: Analytics and AI executive who brings science, data, and emerging AI capabilities to life through business storytelling and decisive action — turning analytics from a cost center into a trusted engine for business outcomes.

signature_problems.label: Analytics disconnected from business
signature_problems.description: When analytics is only used tactically or for reporting, it loses credibility, isn't trusted, and ultimately isn't used — causing organizations to forgo significant enterprise value. As AI becomes more accessible, this disconnect becomes more dangerous because faster tools only accelerate bad decisions when analytics lacks credibility.

signature_problems.label: Gap between vision and execution
signature_problems.description: Many organizations have strong analytics visions but fail in execution, adoption, and scale. Strategy exists, but value never materializes.

signature_problems.label: Analytics built at wrong speed
signature_problems.description: When analytics isn't built to operate at business speed and with business outcomes in mind, it answers the wrong questions at the wrong time — rendering even good analysis irrelevant. AI amplifies this failure — models deliver answers instantly, but without the right questions, operating model, and decision rights, speed destroys value instead of creating it.

proof_anchors.label: Enterprise Decision Enablement at Scale (Diageo)
proof_anchors.summary: Built custom forecast of sales potential for every brand and package across every outlet in the US, enabling sales teams to prioritize highest-value distribution gaps. Generated $64M-$120M incremental annual revenue, representing 10% of total US growth for $4B+ business unit.

proof_anchors.label: Value Protection and CEO-Level Partnership (H&R Block)
proof_anchors.summary: Prevented $180M-$360M in annual revenue erosion by declining widespread price reduction pressure. Instead implemented strategic pricing increases yielding $50M in annual incremental revenue. Operated as trusted CEO-level advisor on long-term strategic planning.

proof_anchors.label: Data Waiter to Decision Engine Transformation
proof_anchors.summary: Repeated pattern across every organization: inherited analytics teams treated as data waiters and order-takers, transformed them into trusted strategic advisors embedded in business decisions. Measurable culture shifts (e.g., employee engagement doubled from 40% to 80% at H&R Block).

ens.transformation_thread: Data waiter to decision engine — the consistent thread across every role is transforming analytics from a cost center and order-taking function into a trusted engine for business decisions.
ens.differentiator: Geek that can Speak — distinctly technical for a C-suite executive, but leads with business outcomes and board-ready storytelling, not technology. Combines DBA-level analytical rigor with Fortune 500 commercial instincts.
